data.desc: SciSparc Ltd. is undergoing a strategic transformation toward Agentic AI-powered technologies, with a focus on applications in cybersecurity and finance. Building on its decision to target the Agentic AI market and the establishment of a Scientific Advisory Board for AI and cybersecurity, the Company is evaluating technologies, companies and business opportunities across the Agentic AI ecosystem. Agentic AI refers to artificial intelligence systems designed to autonomously plan and execute tasks to achieve defined objectives. In parallel, through its subsidiary NeuroThera Labs Inc. ('NeuroThera'), SciSparc continues to advance its clinical-stage cannabinoid pharmaceutical programs, including SCI-110 for Tourette syndrome and Alzheimer's disease-related agitation, and SCI-210 for autism spectrum disorder and status epilepticus. NeuroThera also holds a controlling interest in a subsidiary that sells hemp seed oil-based products on Amazon.com.
